item.title: Crowdsourcing Warmth: Our Partnership with Project Linus
item.description:
What happens after you drop off your finished 7” x 9” square at the Pickcode booth?

Every square donated to Blanket Statement becomes part of a larger community quilt. In this post, we take a look behind the scenes at how hundreds of individual contributions become cozy blankets for Project Linus.

About Project Linus

Project Linus is a national non-profit organization that provides handmade blankets to children who are seriously ill, traumatized, or otherwise in need. Since its founding in 1995, Project Linus has delivered more than 10 million blankets nationwide.

item.title: Welcome to Blanket Statement
item.description:
Welcome to Blanket Statement!

If you’ve ever attended an all-day conference, faculty meeting, or professional development workshop, you know how hard it can be to sit motionless for hours at a time. Many of us are kinesthetic learners: we need our hands engaged in rhythmic, low-cognitive-load activity to keep our minds alert and receptive.

“Folks who knit or crochet when attending talks and meetings do so in order to help maintain focus on the talk. Using our hands keeps our brains from wandering from the speaker.”
